column1: # kdeconnect components: kind  name  key  description  flags (see lib/components.sh)
# Ids: a device's id; DEVICE/NOTIFICATION, DEVICE/COMMAND and DEVICE/THREAD in the other modes.
mode    devices        -       paired and nearby devices, connected first                 default
mode    notifications  -       the notifications on the connected devices                 -
mode    commands       -       the commands the connected devices offer to run            -
mode    sms            -       SMS conversations on the connected devices                 -
mode    chat           -       one SMS conversation (--thread DEVICE/THREAD): what you type is the reply  hidden,nopersist
sort    state          -       devices: connected first                                   default
sort    recent         -       sms: newest first                                          default,desc
sort    name           -       devices, sms: by name                                      -
action  ping       alt-p   devices: send a ping                                           notify
action  ring       alt-i   devices: ring it, to find it                                   notify
action  clipboard  alt-v   devices: send this computer's clipboard                        notify
action  share      alt-s   devices: share a file or URL (asked for)                       foreground
action  text       alt-t   devices: share some text (asked for)                           foreground
action  keys       alt-k   devices: send keystrokes to what is focused there (asked for)  foreground
action  sms        alt-m   devices: send an SMS (number and message asked for, then confirmed)  asks
action  lock       alt-l   devices: lock it                                               confirm
action  unlock     alt-u   devices: unlock it                                             confirm
action  pair       alt-P   devices: ask to pair (accept on the device)                    notify,reload
action  unpair     alt-x   devices: unpair (pairing again takes the device)               confirm,reload
action  refresh    alt-c   look for devices on the network again                          notify,reload
action  dismiss    alt-d   notifications: dismiss                                         notify,reload
action  run        alt-e   commands: run it on the device                                 confirm
